themes.summary: A framework suggests bonds will bottom when market fear shifts from continued selloff in a hot economy to concerns about a lack of rally during an economic slowdown, signaling a buying opportunity.

mentions.text:
The best framework for when bonds will bottom is when the crowd’s fear shifts broadly from their continued selloff in a hot economy to concerns that they won’t rally if we have an economic slowdown. 

If people start saying that, it’s time to buy.
